## Personality

A kind, good-hearted, and pious woman, she is known as an exceptionally capable individual who can comfortably manage her own affairs as well as those of others. Her practical nature is paired with a farseeing mind and an acute observation of everything occurring around her, making her a keen judge of human nature. Highly outspoken and prone to speaking her mind without fear, she can be critical, bossy, and gossipy, yet she remains honest enough to admit to her own mistakes. While she firmly believes in foreordination and holds a dubious view toward women's higher education and fiction writing, she is devoted to church work, generous to the poor, and loves being asked for advice. She is also notably skilled in crafting homemade butter and cheese.

## History

Mrs. Rachel Lynde was married at eighteen years old, went on to send ten children to school, and brought up ten children while burying two. Observing [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) leaving [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) in a buggy, she visited [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and voiced strong disapproval upon learning that he and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) planned to adopt an orphan boy. Soon after [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived instead, Mrs. Lynde visited to meet her but offended the girl with blunt remarks about her hair, prompting an explosive outburst from [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). Mrs. Lynde later returned and completely forgiven [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after receiving a dramatic apology, and she subsequently advised [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) on how to handle Anne's choice to temporarily stay home from school. She also assisted [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) by picking out a stylish puffed-sleeve dress for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and she later commended Anne's growth to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md). Following her husband [Thomas](../character/thomas-lynde.md) Lynde's death, Mrs. Lynde accepted Marilla's invitation to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) so that [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) could attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college). Living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she helped care for the home and maintained strict authority over the young twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, frequently disciplining [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) for his misbehavior. She also remained a central source of community news, sharing local gossip with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) during Anne's visits home from college.

## Quotes

> "Child, yes, I’m afraid of it. Look at his face. When you’ve seen that look as often as I have you’ll know what it means."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v1 CHAPTER XXXVII. The Reaper Whose Name Is Death P7](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0007)

> "I saw Mr. Harrison chasing your Jersey out of his oats today when I was coming home from Carmody. I thought he looked pretty mad. Did he make much of a rumpus?"
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P38](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0038)

> "I knew there’d be trouble when Robert Bell sold his place to a New Brunswick man, that’s what. I don’t know what Avonlea is coming to, with so many strange people rushing into it. It’ll soon not be safe to go to sleep in our beds."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P43](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0043)

> "And every one of them said they liked you splendid, Anne, except Anthony Pye. I must admit he didn’t. He said you ‘weren’t any good, just like all girl teachers.’ There’s the Pye leaven for you. But never mind."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 V A Full-fledged Schoolma’am P26](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0026)

> "Well, I wish you would. I guess we’ll have the supper in about a fortnight’s time. Uncle Abe Andrews is prophesying rain and storms for about that time; and that’s a pretty sure sign we’ll have fine weather."
>
> — Rachel Lynde — [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P8](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0008)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde initial introduction to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) was rocky when her blunt remarks about Anne's red hair provoked a fiery outburst, though she completely forgave [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) after receiving a dramatic apology. Over time, Rachel became an advisor to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) regarding Anne's upbringing, such as recommending she be allowed to stay home from school until she cooled off following a humiliation. The two developed a genuine friendship, with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) turning to Mrs. Lynde for help in resolving misunderstandings.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P14](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER IX. ### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--rachel-lynde.md)

Mrs. Rachel Lynde and [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) are longtime neighbors and friends who regularly visit each other for tea and gossip. Rachel freely voices her blunt opinions and concerns to [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), such as her initial disapproval when [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) decided to adopt an orphan. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) frequently consults Rachel for practical advice on managing home affairs and raising children.
